Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: Incorrect comparative logic in the final conclusion. The Planner correctly identified that Nunzio Malasomma was born in 1894 and Don McGuire was born in 1919. However, the Planner concluded that "Johnny Concho has the older director" by stating Don McGuire was 37 at the time of his film (1956) while Malasomma was 31 at the time of his film (1925). This reasoning is flawed because the question asks which director is *older* (i.e., who was born earlier), not who was older *at the time of their respective films*. Since 1894 is earlier than 1919, Nunzio Malasomma is the older director, meaning the film "One Minute to Twelve" has the older director. The Planner reversed the conclusion based on a misinterpretation of the age comparison criteria.
